name: Rina Akiyama
source:
Likes: Having control of things
Dislikes: Unruly younger people

Rina is the voluptuous history teacher of Haruka Academy. She's a proud and authoritarian woman, who doesn't like people getting out of line or defying her. As such, Rina is feared and resented by many students in the academy. Her looks, however, also make her highly desired by the male student body of the school, and her curves had earned her the secret nickname of "Peach Hips".
